card.name: "of" after inhibitors or inducers
card.fires_on: The word "of" (or "many"/"multiple") right after "inhibitors", "inducers" or "substrate for", just before a CYP or cytochrome P450 enzyme name in drug interaction text.

modes.label: Inhibitors/inducers of
modes.description: The word "of" after "Inhibitors" or "Inducers" in interaction headings, before an enzyme name.

modes.label: Quantity word before enzymes
modes.description: "many" or "multiple" after "substrate for" or "inhibitor of", before enzymes or transporters.
modes.example: Cyclosporine is an inhibitor of<< multiple>> transporters, including P-gp.

card.plain: It fires on the small word that comes just before an enzyme name like CYP3A4 or cytochrome P450 in drug interaction sections.
